shortForecast: Showers And Thunderstorms Likely then Partly Cloudy
name: Tonight
detailedForecast: A slight chance of rain showers between 7pm and 8pm, then showers and thunderstorms likely between 8pm and 10pm. Partly cloudy, with a low around 71. Southwest wind 3 to 9 mph. Chance of precipitation is 70%. New rainfall amounts less than a tenth of an inch possible.
